title: Ktarian cone types
description: Cone archetypes. See CONE_TYPES.md for units, preview controls, runtime variation and validation behavior. Cross-field height constraints and unique names are checked by the runtime validator.

S1-R.description: Bottom radius as a percentage of the standard 0.88-unit mouth radius.

S1-H.description: First height landmark as a percentage of the full 2.5-unit centerline. Absolute from the base, not a segment length.

S2-R.description: Radius at S1-H as a percentage of the standard mouth radius.

S2-H.description: Second absolute height landmark, in percent. Must be at least 1 percentage point above S1-H.

S3-R.description: Radius at S2-H as a percentage of the standard mouth radius.

S3-ER.description: Final mouth radius multiplier. 1 is standard, 1.1 is 110 percent. This is not a percentage value.

OC.description: Aperture center offset toward the lower edge of its plane, as a percentage of the final mouth radius.

OR.description: Mouth tilt in degrees from upright. 0 is upright; 90 faces sideways.

OR-Y.description: Signed mouth heading in degrees. Side columns mirror its magnitude inward; the center column preserves the sign.

BH.description: Bend pivot height as a percentage of the full centerline. With BA > 0, must be at least 2 percentage points below S2-H.

BA.description: Maximum additional upper-body bend in degrees. 0 disables bending.

BO.description: Bend heading offset in degrees relative to OR-Y.

OR-B.description: Whether the mouth rotates with the upper-body bend. False preserves the base mouth orientation during bending.
